data_description.favorite_brands: e.g. Gösser, Stiegl, Ottakringer. You get an alarm when one of them is on offer.
data_description.max_price_per_liter: You also get an alarm when any beer is cheaper than this per liter.
data_description.ai_task_entity: Optional. PENNY, Lidl, MPREIS and BILLA are read without AI. The AI only helps when a PDF leaflet has a different layout and nothing is found.
data_description.radius_km: Only stores with a branch within this distance of the home location set in Home Assistant. 0 = all. Branches come from OpenStreetMap, which is asked for a coarsely rounded area around your home. The start address is looked up once at OpenStreetMap and shown in the card.
